preconditions.description: Number of vertices (n) and edges (m) are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ui <= n and 1 <= vi <= n for ui, vi in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are within the range of vertex indices.
The number of edges matches the given count.

postconditions.expression: return_value == '-1' or (len(return_value) == 4 and isinstance(return_value[0], int) and isinstance(return_value[2], int))
postconditions.description: Output is either '-1' or consists of two valid vertex cover descriptions.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies (return_value[0] + return_value[2] == n and len(set(return_value[1]) & set(return_value[3])) == 0)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the total number of vertices in both covers equals n and they are disjoint.

postconditions.expression: return_value != '-1' implies all(any(u in return_value[1] or v in return_value[1] for u, v in edges) and any(u in return_value[3] or v in return_value[3] for u, v in edges))
